resumen: Urgencia derivada al 112: no se reserva

eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I need a doctor. My husband's face has gone droopy on one side, his arm's gone weak all of a sudden, and his words are slurred.
Urgencia: señal de ictus (1,00). Deriva al 112, no reserva
What you're describing needs urgent attention, not an appointment. Please hang up and call one one two now, or go to the nearest emergency department. I'm flagging this call for our medical team.
